common.offlineNothingChanged: We could not reach the server. Nothing was changed. Try again.
common.offlineTryAgain: We could not reach the server. Try again.
common.offlineConnection: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
common.somethingWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
common.notFromUs: This request did not come from {product}.
common.legalInEnglish: The legal text below is in English. It is what you agree to.
common.legalAboveInEnglish: The statement above is in English. It is what you confirm.
abuse.doneAlready: You have already reported this document. The {product} administrators have your report.
abuse.doneReported: Thank you. Your report has gone to the {product} administrators, who will look at it.
abuse.doneTail: You do not have to sign anything. If you think you are being defrauded, do not send money or personal details to anyone because of this document.
abuse.open: Not expecting this, or something looks wrong? Report this document
abuse.title: Report this document
abuse.intro: Tell us what is wrong, for example that you do not know the sender or that it asks for something suspicious. Your report goes to the people who run {product}, not to the sender. Reporting does not sign or decline anything.
abuse.label: What is wrong?
abuse.failed: The report could not be sent. Please try again.
abuse.reasonShort: Say in a few words what is wrong.
abuse.unreadable: That report could not be read. Try again.
abuse.openAgain: Open your link again, then report the document from that page.
page.title: Sign document
page.endedBody: For your security a signing session lasts two hours. Open the link from your email again to continue where you left off.
page.ipEndedBody: Please hand the device back to {host}. They can start it again from the document if needed.
page.ipLockedBody: For privacy this screen locked itself. Please hand the device to {host} to unlock it.
page.ipThanksTitle: Thank you, {name}. Your signature is recorded.
page.ipThanksBody: Please hand the device back to {host} now. A copy of the completed document will be sent to your email address.
page.holdBody: This document is on hold. {product} has suspended the account that sent it while a concern is being looked into. You cannot sign it right now. Do not send money or personal details to anyone because of this document. If you know the sender, contact them another way.
page.gateTitle: One more step before your document opens
page.gateBody: Hello {name}. The sender asked for an extra check that it is really you. This protects you if someone else gets hold of your link.
page.gateTries: You get five tries. After that the link is locked for a while so that nobody can guess the code.
page.groupBody: {by} signed "{title}" for your signing group "{group}" on {date}. Nothing more is needed from you.
page.groupBodyNoDate: {by} signed "{title}" for your signing group "{group}". Nothing more is needed from you.
page.senderOwn: You are signing your own document
page.completeBody: Everyone has signed "{title}". Download your copy and keep it somewhere safe.
page.downloadUntil: This link keeps working for downloads until {date}.
page.closedTitle: This document is no longer open for signing
page.closedBody: Ask {sender} if you think this is a mistake.
page.recordedApproval: Thank you. Your approval is recorded.
page.recordedSignature: Thank you. Your signature is recorded.
page.recordedBody: Other people still need to finish this document. When everyone has, the completed document will be available through this same link, and by email if the sender is using email.
page.allDoneBody: The final document is being prepared. This page will offer the download as soon as it is ready, usually within a minute.
page.withdrawn: You withdrew your consent to sign electronically. The sender has been told. If you change your mind, you can agree again below and start over.
page.paperAsked: You asked for a paper copy. The sender has been told.
page.nothingTitle: Nothing is waiting for you here
page.nothingBody: There is no signing step left for you on this document.
consent.agree: I am {name}, and I agree to use electronic records and signatures for this document.
consent.paperHint: Do not want to sign electronically? Use "Ask for a paper copy" below.
final.preparing: Preparing the final document… you can also close this page and come back later with the same link.
declined.title: You declined this document
declined.body: It has been stopped for everyone and the sender has been told, together with your reason if you gave one. Nothing was signed on your behalf. You can close this page.
declined.mistake: If you declined by mistake, ask the sender to send the document again.
handed.title: You handed this document to someone else
handed.body: Your link no longer works, and nothing was signed on your behalf. The person you named has their own link: they get it by email if the sender sends by email, otherwise from the sender. The sender has been told who and why. You can close this page.
handed.mistake: If you did this by mistake, ask the sender to give the document back to you.
gate.accessHint: The sender gave you this code separately, for example by phone or in person. It is not in the email with your link.
gate.otpSent: We emailed a code to {email}. It works once, for 10 minutes. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.
gate.otpDelayed: The code email is delayed because today’s email allowance is used up. It will be sent after the daily reset (00:00 UTC). If this is urgent, contact the sender.
gate.otpFailed: The last code email could not be sent. Ask for a new code.
gate.otpIntro: We will email a 6-digit code to {email}, the address the sender has for you.
gate.errExpired: Your session has ended. Open your link again.
gate.errBadRequest: That request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
gate.errNoAccessCode: This link does not use an access code. Reload the page.
gate.errTypeCode: Type the access code you were given.
gate.errCheckFailed: The code could not be checked. Please try again.
gate.errWrongAccess: That code is not right. Check capital letters and spaces. {tries}
gate.errNoEmailCode: This link does not use an emailed code. Reload the page.
gate.okSent: A code is on its way to your email. It usually arrives within a minute and works for 10 minutes.
gate.errJustRequested: A code was just requested. Wait a minute before asking for another one, and check your spam folder.
gate.errTooManyCodes: Too many codes were requested in the last hour. Try again in an hour.
gate.errSendFailed: A code could not be sent. Please try again.
gate.errSixDigits: Type the 6 digits from the email.
gate.errCodeExpired: That code is no longer valid (codes work once, for 10 minutes). Ask for a new one below.
gate.lockedForever: Too many wrong codes. This link is now locked. Ask the person who sent you the document to unlock it.
gate.lockedFor: Too many wrong codes. For your protection this link is locked for {span}. Nothing else has changed; try again after that.
decline.title: Decline this document?
decline.body: Declining stops the document for everyone. Nobody else will be able to sign it, and the sender is told straight away. This cannot be undone; the sender would have to send a new document.
decline.reason: Reason (optional; the sender will see it)
handoff.title: Hand this document to someone else?
handoff.body: The sender allows this, for example when a colleague has the authority to sign. Your link stops working straight away and anything you have started here is cleared. The new person gets their own link, and the sender is told who you chose and why.
handoff.name: Their name
handoff.reason: Reason (optional; the sender will see it, and it is shown on the document’s certificate)
paper.done: Done. The sender has been told and will decide how to get a paper copy to you.
paper.body: The sender is told straight away and decides how to provide the paper copy. This does not stop you signing here; if you would rather not sign electronically at all, use "Withdraw consent" instead.
paper.note: Note for the sender (optional), for example where to send it
withdraw.title: Withdraw your consent to sign electronically?
withdraw.body: Anything you have filled in or signed on this document is cleared, and you cannot sign until you agree again. The sender is told straight away. The document is not cancelled: the sender decides what happens next.
withdraw.alsoPaper: Also ask the sender for a paper copy
withdraw.reason: Reason (optional; the sender will see it)
q.intro: Ask about anything in the document before you decide. Only you and the sender see this conversation; it is kept with the document’s record.
q.label: Your question
q.offline: We could not reach the server. Your question was not sent. Try again.
ip.idle: For privacy the screen locks in {n} seconds. Touch the screen or press any key to keep going.
ip.errWrongPin: That PIN is not right. After 5 wrong PINs the signing ends and you must sign in again.
attach.tooBig: Attachment: files can be up to 5 MB.
attach.failedDefault: the file could not be attached. Try again.
attach.errHold: This document is on hold and cannot be changed right now.
attach.errSize: Files can be up to 5 MB.
attach.errRead: The file could not be read. Try again.
attach.errType: Attach a PDF, PNG or JPG file.
attach.errStore: The file could not be stored. Try again.
link.incomplete: This signing link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or ask the sender for a new one.
link.cannotOpen: This signing link could not be opened. Try again in a moment.
link.offline: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and open the link again.
link.titleWaiting: It is not your turn yet
link.noscript: Signing needs JavaScript. Turn it on in your browser and open the link again.
link.errInvalid: This signing link is not valid, or it has expired. Ask the sender for a new one.
link.errTurn: It is not your turn yet. Other people sign this document before you. You will be told when it is ready for you; this same link will work then.
room.view: For your information. Nothing is needed from you.
room.openPdf: Open the document as a PDF
room.openPdfTail: to read it in your own PDF app or with a screen reader (opens in a new tab).
room.loadError: The document could not be displayed. Reload the page to try again.
room.signatureInPlace: Your signature is in place. Change it
room.initialsInPlace: Your initials are in place. Change it
room.lockedField: {label}, filled in by the sender, cannot be changed
room.calcTitle: Calculated for you from your entries
room.saveOffline: We could not reach the server. Your last entry is not saved yet.
room.finishOffline: We could not reach the server. Nothing was recorded. Try again.
room.asApprover: Approving as {name} ({email}). After this step your approval cannot be withdrawn here.
room.asSigner: Signing as {name} ({email}). After this step the document cannot be changed.
field.name: Name
field.title: Title
check.checkbox: Tick the box or leave it empty.
check.broken: This field is set up wrongly. Tell the sender.
check.email: Enter an email address, like name@example.com
check.phone: Enter a phone number: digits, spaces, brackets or a dash, 6 to 20 characters
check.custom: This does not have the expected format
sig.fileSignature: Picture of your signature (PNG or JPG, dark ink on white paper)
sig.fileInitials: Picture of your initials (PNG or JPG, dark ink on white paper)
sig.drawHint: Draw in the box with your finger, a pen or the mouse. Using only a keyboard? Choose Type.
sig.errPick: Choose a PNG or JPG picture smaller than 5 MB.
sig.errNoInk: We could not find a signature in that picture. Use dark ink on plain white paper, or draw it instead.
sig.errOpen: That picture could not be opened. Try another one, or draw your signature instead.
sig.errPrepare: Your browser could not prepare the image. Try again.
act.expired: Your signing session has ended. Open the link from your email again.
act.tickBox: Tick the box to agree, or close this page to sign on paper instead.
act.consentFailed: Your agreement could not be recorded just now. Nothing was changed. Try again in a minute.
act.valueTooLong: That value could not be saved. Keep it under 500 characters.
act.sigUnreadable: That signature could not be read. Try again.
act.sigTooLarge: That signature image is too large. Try a simpler one.
act.drawSignature: Draw or type your signature first.
act.drawInitials: Draw or type your initials first.
act.sigSaveFailed: Your signature could not be saved. Try again.
act.handoffName: Enter the name of the person you are handing this to.
act.handoffCheck: Check the name and email address.
act.ownEmail: That is your own email address. Give the other person’s address.
act.badDate: Your device reported an unusual date. Check its clock and try again.
act.calcBroken: A calculated amount cannot be worked out ({error}). Check the numbers you entered; if they are right, contact the sender.
db.alreadyDone: You have already finished this document.
db.checkNeeded: Pass the extra identity check first.
db.consentRequired: Agree to use electronic records and signatures first.
db.consentVersion: This consent wording is not on file.
db.date: The date on your device looks wrong. Check its clock and try again.
db.fieldsMissing: Some required fields are still empty.
db.fieldCannotFill: That field cannot be filled in.
db.fieldNoFile: That field cannot take a file.
db.fieldReadonly: The sender filled this in and it cannot be changed.
db.groupDone: {name} has already signed for your signing group; nothing more is needed from you.
db.inPersonLocked: The screen is locked; hand the device to the host to unlock it.
db.inPersonOnly: This person signs in person on the host.
db.conversationFull: This conversation is full. Contact the sender another way.
db.handedTooOftenDoc: This document has been handed over too many times. Contact the sender.
db.handedTooOftenPart: This part has been handed over too many times. Contact the sender.
db.noLongerOpen: This document is no longer open.
db.noLongerOpenSigning: This document is no longer open for signing.
db.linkInvalid: This link is no longer valid.
db.handoffNotAllowed: The sender has not allowed handing this document to someone else.
db.notAnActor: There is nothing for you to sign on this document.
db.notYourTurn: It is not your turn yet. You will be told when the document is ready for you.
db.noCheckInProgress: There is no code check to finish.
db.noAccessCode: This link does not use an access code.
db.noEmailCode: This link does not use an emailed code.
db.holdOpen: This document is on hold and cannot be opened right now.
db.holdSign: This document is on hold and cannot be signed right now.
db.signatureChanges: You have changed your signature too many times. Use the one you have, or ask the sender for a new link.
db.approverOnly: An approver approves or declines; there is nothing to sign.
form.naBody: The link may be mistyped, or the person who shared it has paused or removed the form.
form.intro: Enter your name and email address. Your own copy of the document is made for you and opens straight away for you to review and sign.
form.introCheck: Before it opens, a code is sent to your email address to check it is yours.
form.warning: Only use this form if you know {owner}. Do not send money or passwords because of a form like this.
form.name: Your full name
form.errTooFast: Please take a moment to check your details, then send again.
form.errOld: This page is too old. Reload it and try again.
form.errOpenFailed: Your document was made, but could not be opened. Contact the sender.
form.errNameLong: Your name can be up to 120 characters.
form.errRefused: Your submission could not be accepted. Reload the page and try again.
form.errPrepare: The form could not be prepared right now. Try again later.
form.errCapToday: This form is not taking more submissions today. Try again tomorrow.
form.errNotNow: This form is not accepting submissions right now.
email.buttonFallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
email.noAccount: You do not need an account.
email.viewNoAction: Nothing is needed from you; you will also receive the completed copy.
email.reqSignReminderSubject: Reminder: "{title}" is still waiting for you to sign
email.reqApproveReminderSubject: Reminder: "{title}" is still waiting for you to approve
email.reqViewReminderSubject: Reminder: "{title}" is still waiting for you to read
email.reqSignHeading: A document is waiting for your signature
email.reqApproveHeading: A document is waiting for your approval
email.reqViewHeading: A document has been shared with you
email.reqSignReminderHeading: Reminder: a document is waiting for your signature
email.reqApproveReminderHeading: Reminder: a document is waiting for your approval
email.reqViewReminderHeading: Reminder: a document has been shared with you
email.reqSignBody: {sender} has sent you {title} to review and sign.
email.reqApproveBody: {sender} has sent you {title} to review and approve.
email.reqSignReminderBody: This is a reminder that {sender} sent you {title} to review and sign, and it is still waiting.
email.reqApproveReminderBody: This is a reminder that {sender} sent you {title} to review and approve, and it is still waiting.
email.reqViewReminderBody: This is a reminder that {sender} sent you {title} to read, and it is still waiting.
email.reqFootnote: This link is personal to you and works until {date}. Do not forward this email: anyone who has the link can {act}. If you were not expecting this document, ignore this email, or open the link and choose “Report this document” at the bottom of the page: opening it signs nothing.
email.reqTextPersonal: The link is personal to you and works until {date}. Do not forward this email: anyone who has the link can {act}.
email.reqTextUnexpected: If you were not expecting this document, ignore this email, or open the link and choose "Report this document" at the bottom of the page: opening it signs nothing.
email.replyConversation: The whole conversation is on the document page. Nothing has been signed.
email.replyFootnote: This link is personal to you and works until {date}. Do not forward this email: anyone who has the link can act on the document.
email.replyTextFootnote: The link is personal to you and works until {date}. Do not forward this email: anyone who has the link can act on the document.
email.otpBody: You asked for a code to open {title}. Type it into the page where you asked for it:
email.otpValidity: The code works once and for {minutes} minutes.
email.otpFootnote: If you did not ask for this code, you can ignore this email: nobody can open the document without it. Never give this code to anyone, including someone who says they are from {product}.
email.voidPreheader: {sender} cancelled this document. Nothing more is needed from you.
email.voidBody: {sender} has cancelled {title}. The link you were sent no longer works and nothing more is needed from you.
email.voidSigned: If you had already signed, your signature does not take effect: the document was never completed.
email.voidFootnote: If you have questions, contact {sender} directly. Replies to this email are not read.
email.voidTextFootnote: If you have questions, contact {sender} directly.
email.donePreheader: Everyone has signed. Your copy is attached.
email.doneBody: {title} is complete. The signed PDF and its certificate of completion are attached to this email. Keep them somewhere safe.
email.doneTextBody: {title} is complete. The signed PDF and its certificate of completion are attached. Keep them somewhere safe.
